stories.headline: PIF approves domestic-focused 2026–2030 strategy, shifting investment priorities away from international exposure
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund board, chaired by Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, approved a new five-year strategy on April 15 that redirects 80% of investments toward six domestic economic ecosystems, down from a previously higher international weighting. PIF Governor Yasir Al-Rumayyan confirmed assets under management reached SR3.4 trillion and said the fund aims to increase annual capital spending to $70 billion post-2025, while explicitly moving away from the rapid international expansion phase of the previous cycle.

stories.headline: PIF reportedly ending LIV Golf funding and selling Al Hilal stake amid broader sports disinvestment
stories.summary: Multiple reports emerged this week that Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund plans to end its financial backing of LIV Golf after the 2026 season, with Fox News confirming the development via named sources. Simultaneously, PIF sold its 70% stake in Al Hilal football club to Kingdom Holding Company (Prince Alwaleed bin Talal) for approximately SAR 1.4 billion. LIV Golf CEO Scott O'Neil issued statements asserting the 2026 season would continue as planned but offered no clarity on post-2026 funding. Both moves are being widely linked to PIF's new domestic-focused 2026–2030 strategy and the financial pressure of the Iran war.

stories.headline: NEOM restructured around near-term projects; Port of NEOM emerges as Hormuz-bypass logistics corridor
stories.summary: PIF Governor Al-Rumayyan confirmed this week that no NEOM projects have been cancelled, though some have been delayed, and that Oxagon industrial hub is now the priority over The Line. Simultaneously, the Port of NEOM announced it is fully operational and has enabled a new multimodal Europe-Egypt-GCC trade corridor that bypasses the Strait of Hormuz, gaining coverage as a strategic alternative route during the Iran war. PIF's 2026–2030 strategy designates NEOM as an independent ecosystem within its Vision Portfolio.

stories.headline: Saudi FM conducts intensive diplomatic blitz on Iran war, Hormuz shipping, and regional ceasefire
stories.summary: Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan engaged in at least nine publicly disclosed rounds of diplomatic consultations in 48 hours following the US-Iran Islamabad talks, including phone calls with his Iranian, US (Secretary Rubio), Russian (Lavrov), UAE, Egyptian, Jordanian, and Pakistani counterparts, focused on ensuring Strait of Hormuz shipping continuity and consolidating the Lebanon ceasefire. Faisal also traveled to Antalya for the Diplomacy Forum 2026, where he participated in a quadrilateral ministerial meeting with Pakistan, Turkey, and Egypt, and separate Gaza ministerial sessions.

stories.headline: Saudi Arabia commits $8 billion to Pakistan amid UAE debt deadline; MBS meets PM Sharif in Jeddah
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia announced a combined $8 billion financial support package for Pakistan: a $3 billion fresh deposit at the State Bank of Pakistan plus an extension of a $5 billion existing deposit, authorized under directives from King Salman and Crown Prince MBS. Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif in Jeddah on April 16 to discuss the support, bilateral defense ties, and regional de-escalation; Sharif had also met with Saudi Finance Minister Al-Jadaan in Islamabad days earlier. The support is linked to an end-of-April UAE debt repayment deadline facing Pakistan.
